about.title: Personal Injury Help in Novato, California
about.longDescription: Novato sits along the US-101 corridor, with Redwood Boulevard, Novato Boulevard, and San Marin Drive carrying much of the city's daily traffic. In the most recent full year on record, Novato saw 153 injury collisions, resulting in 198 people injured and 2 traffic deaths. Behind those numbers are real people dealing with medical bills, missed work, and the stress of figuring out what comes next. We offer free case reviews to injured people in Novato and throughout Marin County. Our team can review what happened and explain your options. There's no charge for that initial consultation, and we work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless we recover money for you. Whether the injury happened on one of Novato's busier roads, in a parking lot, or somewhere else in Marin County, you don't have to sort through insurance calls and paperwork by yourself. Reaching out costs nothing and starts with a simple conversation about what you're dealing with.

whyChoose.title: Why Talk to an Attorney Sooner Rather Than Later

items.title: The Clock Is Running
items.desc: California generally gives you two years from the date of injury to file a claim, but claims against a government entity can be limited to as little as six months. Waiting too long can close the door on your options entirely.

items.title: Being Partly at Fault Doesn't Stop You
items.desc: California follows pure comparative fault, so even if you share some blame for what happened, you can still recover damages — just reduced by your percentage of fault. We can help sort out how fault is being assigned.

items.title: No Cap on What You've Suffered
items.desc: In most ordinary injury cases, California places no limit on non-economic damages like pain and suffering. That matters when an injury affects your daily life well beyond medical bills.

items.title: You Don't Pay Unless We Win
items.desc: We work on contingency, meaning we only get paid if you receive a settlement or award. There's no upfront cost to find out where you stand.

items.question: How much does it cost to talk to an attorney?
items.answer: Nothing. There's no cost to have that first conversation. We work on contingency, so we only get paid if you recover money.

items.question: How long do I have to file a claim in California?
items.answer: For most personal injury claims, California law gives you two years from the date of the injury. If your claim involves a government entity, such as a city road department, that window can be as short as six months, so it's worth acting sooner rather than later.

items.question: What if I was partly responsible for the accident?
items.answer: California uses a pure comparative fault rule, which means you can still recover damages even if you were partly at fault. Your compensation would simply be reduced by your share of responsibility, so it's worth having someone review the details.

items.question: Where do crashes tend to happen in Novato?
items.answer: Public crash records show reported collisions concentrated along corridors like US-101, Redwood Boulevard, Novato Boulevard, and San Marin Drive, with reports peaking on Thursdays between 4 and 6 p.m. These are simply where collision counts are highest on record, not a judgment about any particular road.

items.question: How does this work?
items.answer: We help injured people in Novato and across Marin County get in touch with a personal injury attorney. We don't represent you directly — the attorney handles your case.
